name: RR Metalmakers India Limited
about: RR Metalmakers India Limited manufactures and sells steel pipes, and doors and windows in India. The company offers ERW pipes; pre-painted galvanised sheets (PPGI); PPGI corrugated profile; galvanised G.P. coils/sheets; galvanised corrugated sheets; hot rolled steel coils/sheets; chequered steel coils; and round bars. It is also involved in trading of steel and iron ore. The company also exports iron ore. RR Metalmakers India Limited was formerly known as Shree Surgovind Tradelink Limited and changed its name to RR Metalmakers India Limited in April 2019. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.
